generation.prompt: ONE original flat front-view diffuse face texture for a hand-painted late-1990s fantasy strategy-game mortal religious-practitioner model. Adult woman around 38 with a thoughtful calm face, warm brown skin with amber undertones, dark human eyes, prominent cheek planes, broad compact human nose, closed lips, dark black hair drawn back, subtle age lines; no makeup, no silver tattoos, no horns, no elf ears, no celestial anatomy, no jewelry, no veil or headdress in this skin texture. EXACTLY straight forward, symmetrical perspective, head vertical without tilt; head top y5%, chin y95%, eyes y43%, mouth y72%, maximum head width about75% of square. Transparent background, no shoulders. Original earthy oil-painted skin surface with visible small brush marks, crisp brow/cheek/nose highlights, eyes with tiny pale lights, separated warm and cool face planes. Even diffuse lighting, no dramatic shadow, no gloss, no text or background. This single albedo painting will follow an original fully volumetric articulated human head; no existing champion or named person.
